source.method: Every boundary vertex is an original maxRGB<=45 black pixel on the exact embedded municipal Figure73 JPEG. Dense rings follow only 8-neighbor source-pixel paths guided by manually inspected stroke corridors. A literal black connected-component subset excludes detached photographic specks; no pixel is added, no missing edge is filled and no image-frame closure, buffer, snap, simplification or repair is used. The complete original apartment-back parking zigzag is retained instead of replacing it by an unresolved modern road-node chain. Six approximate historical source-junction observations fit an affine transform to literal current OSM nodes in EPSG:23700. Four old observations are transferred through the exact PDF page-image placement on the same byte-identical Figure73 image; two southern observations are new. A failed earlier same-image Jókai/Piaristák candidate is preserved outside the fit. Exact historical-to-current physical point identity has not been independently validated, so all geographic output remains inferred.

Six approximate historical source-junction observations fit an affine transform to literal current OSM nodes in EPSG:23700. A failed earlier same-image Jókai/Piaristák candidate is preserved outside the fit. Exact historical-to-current physical point identity has not been independently validated, so all geographic output remains inferred.
